q: The Giry monad in categorical probability associates to each measurable space X the space GX of probability measures on X. It models:
opts: Probabilistic transitions, making it the categorical foundation for stochastic processes
exp: The Giry monad G is a monad on Meas: G(X) = {probability measures on X}. Kleisli morphisms X → G(Y) are Markov kernels (stochastic maps), and the monad structure captures composition of stochastic transitions.
